Question ID: ANP_U03_L01_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.ANP.SKM.01

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Bone Tissue Anatomy and Histology
Stimulus: Bone histology/model

A student is reviewing the required visual and must explain the first visible structure-function connection. Which answer uses the lesson evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, distinguish compact and spongy bone. Then use the required stimulus (Bone histology/model) to connect the visible evidence to bone tissue anatomy and histology. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.ANP.SKM.01 and avoids the common mistake: thinking bone is dead solid material.

answer.text: thinking bone is dead solid material This misses the evidence required for Bone Tissue Anatomy and Histology.
